criteria.summary: Exact upstream and baseline tag identity verified.
Upstream remote absent and pre-review tree dirty; ancestry itself is valid.
Baseline source is unchanged, but SA00-T02 integrity manifest is not reproducible from committed bytes.
Commit source boundary is clean; worktree contains unclassified frontend lockfile drift.
Apache-2.0 and attribution/notice responsibilities are preserved and inventoried.
Packaged code retains official AO PostHog defaults.
Updater is wired to the official AO fallback feed and is not hard-disabled through SA14.
Current product, data, runtime, process, app, port, and environment identities remain AO values.
Explicit owner acceptance exists only in untracked SA00-T04 evidence, not the reviewed commit.
Authority files verify in the worktree but are absent from the reviewed commit.
Supersession register content is accurate but absent from the reviewed commit.
Privacy scan passed, but T02/T03 manifest integrity and uncommitted T04 make the evidence set incomplete.

accepted_pre_existing_findings: Windows-specific backend go test failures are preserved as upstream baseline findings.
Race testing was environment-blocked by CGO/toolchain availability.
npm 11 rejects the upstream frontend lock while the documented npm-10 toolchain passes.
Frontend unit failures are classified as Windows/macOS environment-specific.
Playwright e2e was environment-blocked by an unrelated localhost listener.
sqlc has known upstream generated drift while OpenAPI/TypeScript generation reproduces.
Unsigned package and isolated AO daemon/CLI smokes passed and terminated cleanly.
Root npm audit recorded one moderate and two high vulnerabilities without baseline repair.
blockers: Canonical upstream remote is not preserved in current Git configuration.
Review workspace is dirty and includes unclassified frontend/package-lock.json drift.
SA00-T04 authority/ADR/evidence/receipt/supersession artifacts are absent from reviewed_commit.
Telemetry is not hard-disabled by default for packaged downstream builds.
Updater is not hard-disabled through SA14 and retains an official AO feed path.
Square and AO runtime/data/product identities are not implemented as isolated identities.
SA00-T02 and SA00-T03 evidence manifests do not verify against committed bytes.
next_authorized_action: Owner must create and explicitly authorize a new narrowly scoped SA00-FIXxx packet; after its committed receipt, SA00-T05 may be rerun as a superseding independent review.

reviewer.method: raw refs, Git object bytes, ancestry, remotes, diffs, manifest and index recomputation, targeted Go/Vitest tests, source inspection, and privacy pattern scan
